q20426.en: The sign shown orders you to stop at the customs post.

explain.short: The sign says DOGANA (customs): you must stop at the customs post.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'prescrive di arrestarsi' (orders you to stop) is right: it is an order, not advice.

sceneParams.caption: Customs: everyone must stop

q20427.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop at the border for the customs check.

explain.short: At the border the customs officers check vehicles: the DOGANA sign obliges you to stop there.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'alla frontiera' (at the border) is right: customs posts are at the border.

sceneParams.caption: Stop at the border for customs

q20428.en: The sign shown means you must slow down and stop at customs.

explain.short: To stop at customs you first slow down, then stop: that is exactly what the sign asks.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'rallentare e fermarsi' (slow down and stop) is right: you slow down and then stop.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down, then stop at customs

q20429.en: The sign shown marks a customs post where stopping is compulsory.

explain.short: The sign marks the customs post, and there you must stop.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'è obbligatorio fermarsi' (stopping is compulsory) is right: the stop is not optional.

sceneParams.caption: Customs post: stopping is compulsory

q20430.en: The sign shown announces a police station ahead.

explain.short: The sign says DOGANA (customs), not police. It orders you to stop at customs.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'commissariato di polizia' (police station) is wrong: the word on the sign is DOGANA.

sceneParams.caption: It says DOGANA (customs), not police

q20431.en: The sign shown obliges you to slow down and stop at the customs post only if you have items or goods to declare.

explain.short: Everyone must stop at customs, with or without goods to declare.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) is wrong: the stop is for all vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Everyone stops, goods or no goods

q20432.en: The sign shown announces a carabinieri station.

explain.short: The sign says DOGANA (customs), not carabinieri (a police force). It orders a stop at customs.
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'comando stazione carabinieri' is wrong: the word on the sign is DOGANA.

sceneParams.caption: It says DOGANA (customs), not carabinieri

q20433.en: The sign shown is found only at the border with a European Community country.

explain.short: The sign is used at any border customs post, also with countries outside the EU (for example Switzerland).
explain.rule: The DOGANA sign (customs) orders every vehicle to stop at the customs post at the border.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is wrong: it is not limited to EU borders.

sceneParams.caption: At any customs post, not only EU borders

q20434.en: The sign shown announces a road block set up by the police.

explain.short: ALT POLIZIA tells you a police roadblock (posto di blocco) is ahead.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco' (roadblock) is right: ALT POLIZIA means a police roadblock.

sceneParams.caption: Police roadblock ahead

q20435.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop near a road block set up by the police.

explain.short: ALT means stop: at the police roadblock you must stop.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'obbliga ad arrestarsi' (obliges you to stop) is right: ALT is a stop order.

sceneParams.caption: ALT: stop at the police roadblock

q20436.en: The sign shown indicates the obligation to stop at a road block set up by the police.

explain.short: The sign gives an obligation (obbligo): stop at the police roadblock.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'obbligo di arresto' (obligation to stop) is right: the stop is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory stop at the roadblock

q20437.en: The sign shown marks a police road block where stopping is compulsory.

explain.short: The sign marks the police roadblock, and there you must stop.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'è obbligatorio fermarsi' (stopping is compulsory) is right: you always stop.

sceneParams.caption: Police roadblock: stopping is compulsory

q20438.en: The sign shown, placed at a suitable distance from the road block, is repeated at the point where you stop.

explain.short: The first sign warns you in time; a second one stands exactly where you must stop.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'è ripetuto' (is repeated) is right: one sign before, one at the stop point.

sceneParams.caption: One sign before, one at the stop point

q20439.en: The sign shown obliges you to slow down to be ready to stop if the officers signal to you.

explain.short: At ALT POLIZIA you must always stop, even if the officers do not signal to you.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'in caso di segnalazione' (if they signal) is wrong: the stop is always compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Always stop, not only if signalled

q20440.en: The sign shown announces a state border with the obligation to stop.

explain.short: ALT POLIZIA is about a police roadblock. The border sign is DOGANA (customs).
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'confine di Stato' (state border) is wrong: that would be the DOGANA sign.

sceneParams.caption: Police roadblock, not a state border

q20441.en: The sign shown marks a motorway station where stopping is compulsory.

explain.short: The sign says ALT POLIZIA (police). The motorway toll sign says ALT STAZIONE.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'stazione autostradale' (motorway station) is wrong: that is the ALT STAZIONE sign.

sceneParams.caption: POLIZIA, not motorway toll (STAZIONE)

q20442.en: The sign shown orders you to stop and give way to police vehicles.

explain.short: The sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It says nothing about giving way to police vehicles.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'dare precedenza ai mezzi della polizia' (give way to police vehicles) is wrong: it is a roadblock stop.

sceneParams.caption: Stop at the roadblock, not give way

q20443.en: The sign shown warns that a customs check is near.

explain.short: The sign says POLIZIA (police roadblock). The customs sign says DOGANA.
explain.rule: The ALT POLIZIA sign orders you to stop at a police roadblock. It is placed before the roadblock and repeated where you must stop.
explain.trap: 'controllo doganale' (customs check) is wrong: that is the DOGANA sign.

sceneParams.caption: POLIZIA roadblock, not customs (DOGANA)

q20444.en: The sign shown obliges you to stop at the motorway entrance.

explain.short: At the motorway entrance there is a toll station: ALT STAZIONE orders you to stop there.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'accesso autostradale' (motorway entrance) is right: the sign is at the toll gates.

sceneParams.caption: Stop at the motorway entrance

q20445.en: The sign shown imposes the obligation to slow down and stop for paying the motorway toll.

explain.short: At the toll station you slow down and stop to pay the toll (pedaggio).
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'operazioni di pedaggio' (toll payment) is right: you stop to pay.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down and stop to pay the toll

q20446.en: The sign shown marks a motorway station where stopping is compulsory.

explain.short: STAZIONE here means motorway toll station; there you must stop.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'stazione autostradale' (motorway station) is right: ALT STAZIONE is the toll station.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway toll station: stop

q20447.en: The sign shown orders you to stop at the motorway toll booth to pay the toll.

explain.short: At the casello (toll booth) you must stop and pay: that is what the sign orders.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'casello autostradale' (motorway toll booth) is right: the sign stands there.

sceneParams.caption: Stop at the toll booth (casello)

q20448.en: The sign shown is placed at controlled motorway entrances where stopping is compulsory.

explain.short: The sign stands at controlled motorway entrances (toll gates), where you must stop.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'accessi autostradali controllati' (controlled motorway entrances) is right: these are the toll gates.

sceneParams.caption: At controlled motorway entrances

q20449.en: The sign shown marks a carabinieri station with a road block.

explain.short: STAZIONE here is the motorway toll station, not a carabinieri station.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'comando stazione carabinieri' is wrong: STAZIONE means the motorway toll station.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway toll station, not carabinieri

q20450.en: The sign shown announces a railway station.

explain.short: STAZIONE here is the motorway toll station, not a railway station.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'stazione ferroviaria' (railway station) is wrong: it is the motorway toll station.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway toll station, not railway

q20451.en: The sign shown forbids access to an area reserved for the motorway company's vehicles.

explain.short: The sign does not forbid entry: it orders you to stop at the toll station.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'vieta l'accesso' (forbids access) is wrong: it is a stop order, not a no-entry sign.

sceneParams.caption: Stop at the toll, not no entry

q20452.en: The sign shown marks the point where you must stop to load the car onto the train.

explain.short: The sign is for the motorway toll station, not for loading cars onto a train.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'caricare l'autovettura sul treno' (load the car on the train) is wrong: it is the motorway toll.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway toll, not car-on-train

keywords.en: load the car onto the train

q20453.en: The sign shown can mark the stopping point on ferry boarding piers.

explain.short: ALT STAZIONE is used only at motorway toll stations, not at ferry piers.
explain.rule: The ALT STAZIONE sign orders you to stop at the motorway toll station (casello) to pay the toll.
explain.trap: 'pontili d'imbarco di navi traghetto' (ferry piers) is wrong: it is only for the motorway toll.

sceneParams.caption: Only at motorway tolls, not ferries

q20454.en: The sign shown announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t.

explain.short: The blue disc with the right arrow is an obligation, and the lorry below says who it is for: lorries over 3.5 t.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'svolta obbligatoria a destra' (compulsory right turn) is right: the arrow points right.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries over 3.5 t must turn right

q20455.en: The sign shown forbids lorries over 3.5 t to go straight on.

explain.short: If lorries must turn right, they cannot go straight on: so going straight is forbidden for them.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'vieta... di proseguire diritto' (forbids going straight) is right: right is the only way allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries must turn right: no straight on

q20456.en: The sign shown announces the obligation to turn right for the vehicles shown on the sign itself.

explain.short: The obligation is only for the vehicles drawn on the sign: here, lorries.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'veicoli rappresentati nel segnale' (vehicles shown on the sign) is right: only lorries must turn.

sceneParams.caption: Only the vehicles shown must turn right

q20457.en: The sign shown announces a ban on turning left for lorries over 3.5 t.

explain.short: If lorries must turn right, they cannot turn left: so the left turn is banned for them.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'divieto di svolta a sinistra' (no left turn) is right: right is the only way allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries must turn right: no left turn

q20458.en: The sign shown announces a compulsory turn for the vehicles shown on the sign itself.

explain.short: The blue arrow disc is an obligation to turn, valid for the vehicles drawn below: lorries.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'svolta obbligatoria' (compulsory turn) is right: blue round sign = obligation.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory turn for the vehicles shown

q20459.en: The sign shown announces that lorries over 3.5 t must turn in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: Lorries over 3.5 t must follow the arrow, which points right.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'devono svoltare nella direzione della freccia' (must turn where the arrow points) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries follow the arrow: turn right

q20460.en: The sign shown announces a fuel station for lorries.

explain.short: The blue disc with an arrow is an obligation to turn right for lorries, not a fuel station.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'posto di rifornimento' (fuel station) is wrong: there is no fuel pump, only an arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory right turn, not a fuel station

q20461.en: The sign shown announces that lorries are advised to turn right.

explain.short: A blue round sign is an obligation, not advice: lorries MUST turn right.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'consigliato' (advised) is wrong: it is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory, not just advised

q20462.en: The sign shown announces a ban on turning right for the vehicles shown in the picture.

explain.short: It is the opposite: blue round sign = obligation. The lorries must turn right.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'divieto di svoltare a destra' (no right turn) is wrong: right is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Right turn is compulsory, not banned

q20463.en: The sign shown announces a parking area reserved for lorries.

explain.short: There is no P on the sign: the blue disc with an arrow is a compulsory right turn for lorries.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'area di parcheggio' (parking area) is wrong: it is a turn obligation.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory right turn, not parking

q20464.en: The sign shown announces a sign ordering all lorries to turn left.

explain.short: The arrow points right, not left, and it is for lorries over 3.5 t only.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'sinistra' (left) is wrong: the arrow points right.

sceneParams.caption: Right, not left

q20465.en: The sign shown announces a dangerous right bend for passing lorries.

explain.short: A dangerous bend is a red triangle. This blue disc is a compulsory right turn for lorries.
explain.rule: This panel announces a compulsory right turn for lorries over 3.5 t. Those lorries may not go straight or turn left.
explain.trap: 'curva pericolosa' (dangerous bend) is wrong: that would be a red triangle warning sign.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory turn, not a dangerous bend
